in_marathi.name: Darvik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the Thunder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Darvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Darvik is a powerful god associated with thunder and lightning. His name symbolizes his rule over the sky and his mighty power to strike with lightning bolts.
